input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including response, user, book, product. The platform provides capabilities for user, book, book. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage response records, so that I can track and organize response data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
